deleteRule.description: A value that prescribes what should happen to the stateful disk when the VM instance is deleted. The available options are 'NEVER' and 'ON_PERMANENT_INSTANCE_DELETION'. 'NEVER' - detach the disk when the VM is deleted, but do not delete the disk. 'ON_PERMANENT_INSTANCE_DELETION' will delete the stateful disk when the VM is permanently deleted from the instance group. Default value: "NEVER" Possible values: ["NEVER", "ON_PERMANENT_INSTANCE_DELETION"].
